Market order मार्केट ऑर्डर

An order to buy or sell immediately at the best available price. The final price may differ from the displayed one.

हिंदी में: मार्केट ऑर्डर

तुरंत सबसे अच्छी उपलब्ध कीमत पर ख़रीदने या बेचने का ऑर्डर। अंतिम कीमत दिखाई गई कीमत से अलग हो सकती है।

How it is used in the lessons

Market order: buy or sell now at the best available price.

From Stock Market Foundations

A market order buying at ₹500.10 and selling at ₹499.90 immediately loses ₹0.20 per share before any move.
